kernel_evidence.source: external memory sentinel over canonical Darwin physical footprint
kernel_evidence.event: static steady-state ceiling killed the trainer during the bounded resident model-load transient at 63302.6 MB before any optimizer step

diagnosis.root_cause: The 59392-MB steady-state threshold was armed from process birth. Resident checkpoint loading has a measured bounded transient above that threshold, so the sentinel killed the trainer before the repaired graph-lifetime behavior could be exercised.
diagnosis.repair: Use a 73728-MB startup ceiling only through model load and setup. The trainer then publishes a create-once source/PID-bound readiness marker, waits for the sentinel's hash-bound acknowledgement at or below 59392 MB, and cannot start its training clock or first gradient graph until the 59392-MB steady guard is armed.
diagnosis.guard_failure_policy: A malformed marker or acknowledgement kills the target tree and leaves a tombstone; a missing acknowledgement times out the trainer before its first optimizer step.
